Собрал типизированный клиент кабинета MagicSEO: JWT, чтение/мутации из контракта, журнал мутаций, start/stop с проверкой. `package.json` и `tsconfig.json` не трогал — они в `never_touch` и в T3.

Клиент живёт в `lib/magicseo/`. Логин `POST /backend/login`, токен в памяти, повтор, пока `exp` дальше чем на 60 с. На 401 — один повторный логин и один повтор запроса. Тело 200 с непустым `error` даёт `MagicSeoError` без пароля, JWT и текста ответа. Каждая мутация один раз зовёт `onMutation`; чтения и логин — нет. Платежи, transfer, separate_balance, удаление проекта и `/backend/admin/*` не реализованы.

`startPromotion` читает autolaunch и PATCH с теми же полями и `active:true`. `stopPromotion` выключает автопилот, делает `DELETE /job` (404 и ошибка тела не фатальны, если GET уже `active:false`) и до трёх попыток бросает `StopFailedError`.

Проверки: `node --test tests/magicseo/client.test.ts` и `node --test tests/magicseo/lifecycle.test.ts` — 12 тестов, код 0. Дополнительно `node .agents/phases/ph_f16b2b8b06/contracts-v2/check.mjs T1` — `PASS T1`.

Изменённые пути:
- `lib/magicseo/types.ts`
- `lib/magicseo/client.ts`
- `lib/magicseo/lifecycle.ts`
- `tests/magicseo/client.test.ts`
- `tests/magicseo/lifecycle.test.ts`

Решение: `listFolders()` ходит на `GET /backend/folders`, как в интерфейсе и planner check; в recon этот GET не снимали, только POST/PUT/DELETE.

Task T1.4 specifies the development of an isolated, strictly-typed TypeScript client for the private MagicSEO cabinet API (lk.magicseo.ru/backend), alongside supporting domain types and verified promotion lifecycle routines. Based on the read-only reconnaissance documented in .agents/plans/magicseo-api/api-map.md, the cabinet has no public API keys or OpenAPI documentation; integration relies on reverse-engineered internal endpoints authenticated via stateless HS256 JWT tokens obtained from POST /backend/login and passed via Bearer authorization headers. The client implementation must live across three files (lib/magicseo/client.ts, lib/magicseo/types.ts, and lib/magicseo/lifecycle.ts) and be tested using Node.js's native test runner (node --test) without external npm dependencies or package.json requirements by relying strictly on node: built-ins and explicit relative .ts file imports.

The core MagicSeoClient encapsulates credential resolution via a provided async factory, transparent JWT management (caching tokens valid for >60 seconds and executing a single re-login on 401 before retrying), request execution with envelope error handling (translating HTTP 200 responses containing error/error_raw strings into MagicSeoError instances), and structured mutation auditing via an onMutation callback. Crucially, strict security boundaries dictate that credentials (username/password) and raw JWTs must never leak into onMutation payloads, MagicSeoError messages, or console logs. Furthermore, sensitive or dangerous cabinet endpoints—specifically payment operations, balance transfers, separate project balances, project deletions, and administrative routes (/backend/admin/*)—are explicitly out of scope and forbidden from being implemented in the client.

The lifecycle module (lib/magicseo/lifecycle.ts) governs verified promotion startup and teardown. Promotion start (startPromotion) fetches current autolaunch settings and patches active:true while preserving existing configuration. Promotion stop (stopPromotion) patches active:false, invokes DELETE /backend/project/{id}/job, and confirms stoppage via GET autolaunch. In stopPromotion, 404 responses or body errors from DELETE /job are treated as non-fatal if GET autolaunch confirms active:false. If autolaunch remains active, the stop routine retries up to three times before throwing StopFailedError. All behaviors are to be rigorously validated against mocked fetch fixtures in tests/magicseo/client.test.ts and tests/magicseo/lifecycle.test.ts.
